summary.summary: Leo Martins of Vandelay Industries says the pilot is going well and he wants budget to roll Acme out to about 60 operations staff in Q1. SSO (SAML) is the blocker, and he needs a rough date for it. He also says he is fine in principle with Jordan's launch-post quote pending his comms team's review.
summary.ask: Give a rough SSO delivery date, like end of January, for the budget request.

draft:
Leo, great to hear the pilot team is getting real value, and rolling out to the whole operations group in Q1 is exactly what we hoped for.

On SAML SSO, I want to give you a date you can safely put in a budget request rather than a guess, so let me confirm it with our engineering team and come back to you shortly. Could you tell me which identity provider your IT team uses (Okta, Azure AD, or something else)? That will help us scope it accurately and make sure it fits your policy.

No rush on the quote. Take the time you need with your comms team.

Talk soon,
Dana

legend.0: It can wait a week or more, or never needs acting on.
legend.1: It should be handled this week.
legend.2: It should be handled today: someone is blocked or a deadline is days away.
legend.3: It needs attention within the hour: something is broken, money is at risk, or a deadline is today.
